description: This file defines a report module for 'Work Order Summary' in ERPNext, including data retrieval, chart generation, and column configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and charts based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves work order data based on filters, calculating age for non-completed orders.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data based on the selected basis: Status, Age, or Quantity.

methods.name: get_chart_based_on_status
methods.description: Creates a donut chart showing work order counts per status.

methods.name: get_chart_based_on_age
methods.description: Creates a donut chart categorizing work orders by age ranges.

methods.name: get_chart_based_on_qty
methods.description: Creates a bar chart comparing pending and completed quantities over periods.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares labels and data for quantity-based charts over time periods.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table based on filters.
